figurative_meaning_en: An extremely dirty and foul-smelling place
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ঘরটা দেখ খাটালের মতো নোংরা।
example_sentences_in_english: The front yard has turned into a real slaughterhouse.
Look at this room; it's as dirty as a pigsty.
history: Refers to traditional animal slaughter areas in rural Bengal, evoking images of blood and waste.
note: Commonly used to describe neglected, unclean spaces in everyday conversation.
